name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) MUST be mandatory for ALL externally accessible users without exception because it is the single best way to stop account takeover.
conditionsText: Applies to users accessing services from outside the organisation's internal network
requirementTitle: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) MUST be mandatory for ALL externally accessible users without exception because it is the single best way to stop account takeover.
requirementDescription: Anyone who can access a service from outside the organisation's network must use Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). A password alone is not sufficient.
why:
Most account compromises start with:
- Phishing
- Password reuse
- Credential stuffing
- Stolen passwords
- Malware
